result.title: The Verifier Is Part of the Simulator: Evidence-View Gaming in Agentic Equation Discovery
result.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Sim2Science: ML with Imperfect Scientific Models". 28 pages, 5 figures. Code: https://github.com/oroikono/kagamaya
result.summary: A growing number of agentic pipelines search for governing equations: an agent proposes laws and a verifier checks them against simulated trajectories. The verifier sees only a numerical summary: integrals against test functions on a time grid. That summary carries its own discretization error, making the verifier part of the simulator. We freeze the trajectory, candidate library, verifier and thresholds, leaving the agent one move: which permitted summary to admit. Without scores or language models, finer time grids reduce numerical discrepancies and false library rejections. On PDEBench, the verifier instead accepts equations missing diffusion on score-selected summaries. Maximizing a public score rewarding decisive verdicts and larger mismatches when rejecting the library wrongly rejects all 1,500 in-library cases; retrospectively retuning score constants on a separate bank reduces errors to 13/180 at best. We call this evidence-view gaming: reward hacking by choice of permitted summary. In single-turn forced-choice tests, Claude models rarely choose summaries giving wrong verdicts when asked to be accurate, but often do so when asked to maximize the score or report missing physics. In separate trust prompts, they often rank those harmful summaries least trustworthy. Requiring several summaries to agree reduces errors but often withholds a verdict and performs worse than a fixed fine view on PDEBench: a safeguard, not a certificate. Evidence chosen after its verdict is known cannot alone authorize a claim.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 agentic 方程发现中验证器只接收数值摘要（时间网格上测试函数积分）的问题，指出摘要自带离散化误差使验证器成为模拟器的一部分；在冻结轨迹、候选库与阈值的设定下，仅让 agent 选择提交哪份允许摘要，展示了「证据视图博弈」式 reward hacking，并测试 Claude 模型的选择倾向与多摘要一致性防护。
AI.relevance_reason: 将「呈现哪份证据」视为可被奖励指标钻空子的动作，与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、验证器与奖励设计、以及结论能否被授权的问题可能相通，多视图一致只是保障而非证书的结论可供核查。
